summary: Columbus, Ohio, physicist, PhD candidate in computational physics, strong interest in open-source software, particularly Linux and GNOME, advocates for public funding of science, critical of corporate influence in politics, supports social equity and environmental issues, identifies as liberal, enjoys biking and public transportation, has a background in programming (C, Python, Lisp), engaged in discussions about technology and its societal impacts, has lived experience in a Pacific island community, values introspection and personal growth.
